requirements.requirement: Complete proposal received by 2026-09-21 16:30 Central Time.
Submit one complete proposal; TechBid preferred, mailed/carrier route allowed with specified archive USB requirements.
Authorized company official must sign Execution of Offer or satisfy TechBid bidder affirmation; missing signature can disqualify.
Proposal remains valid at least 90 days after deadline.
Complete and return VetHUB Subcontracting Plan; omission is non-responsive.
Acknowledge every buyer addendum through signed Addenda Checklist.
Prove Texas Comptroller current status and Certificate of Franchise Tax status where applicable.
Evidence appropriate certifications, permits, licenses and insurance; agreement also specifies employer/workers comp plus liability/auto coverage.

Treat TX-RAMP as conditional on the proposed delivery model: buyer says it applies to contractor-hosted cloud services (SaaS/PaaS/IaaS); for the stated no-hosted-cloud boundary the buyer says it would not apply, while a managed service inside TTUHSC-approved infrastructure with no contractor-hosted cloud and no institutional data leaving TTUHSC-controlled systems would likely not apply. Actual architecture still controls applicability.
Review and truthfully execute required NDAA 889 / 1260H / foreign-adversary certifications.
Corporate background/experience plus at least 3 current/recent similar references with reachable names/contact information.
Detailed project approach explaining how all Section 5.4 requirements will be met, with work program, deliverables, activities and work-plan outline.
Identify key individuals and subconsultants with qualifications, experience, involvement and time commitment.

Align proposed schedule to buyer planning dates: kickoff Feb 2027; Deliverables 1-2 Apr 2027; Deliverables 3-4 Sep 2027; Deliverable 5 Dec 2027; Deliverable 6 Feb 2028. TTUHSC says dates may change and it will construct a contract term that accommodates completion.
requirements.source: Vendor Questions Addendum schedule amendment / Q645

requirements.requirement: Provide Scope of Work suitable for Exhibit A to Consulting Services Agreement.
Executive alignment, readiness assessment, executable roadmap, governance framework and findings-to-recommendations traceability matrix.
Leadership education, Change Champions Network, communications/change playbooks and train-the-trainer capability handoff.
Role-based curricula, multi-format instruction, sanitized TTUHSC scenarios, enterprise-approved tools, role-specific coaching and searchable internal use-case/prompt repository.

Plan discovery/prioritization/redesign/prototyping around approximately 8-10 workflows across Academic, Clinical, Research and Admin; buyer expects at least two per functional area and solutions that are pilot-ready or fully production-ready, with associated solution costs outside the fixed fee and optionally priced.
Provide agentic deployment/monitoring/control framework plus auditing, approval, access control and HITL oversight for production agents.
Track adoption, usage, proficiency, bottlenecks and transparent buyer-baseline financial/hours/velocity ROI.
FERPA/HIPAA/DIR-aligned data handling; institutional data never used to train/fine-tune/improve vendor/public/third-party models.
Software/data-transfer mechanisms enforce RBAC, SSO integration, TLS 1.3 in transit and AES-256 at rest.
Named Project Lead, detailed plan with milestones/dependencies/escalation, weekly-style operational status and monthly-style executive review tied to KPIs/acceptance.
Cover all six deliverables: strategy/planning, leadership activation, workforce upskilling, workflow/automation, analytics/ROI, knowledge transfer.
Provide not-to-exceed fixed fee per deliverable including associated fees, with level-of-effort schedule, plus hourly resource rate card by resource type valid through 2028-03-31 for change orders.
requirements.source: Vendor Questions Addendum Amendment (3) to RFP 6.1

requirements.requirement: Model cash flow on TTUHSC Net 30 payment terms.
Review Required Terms/Agreement; list exceptions explicitly. Exceptions may cause non-responsiveness/disqualification.
Account for buyer work-made-for-hire / ownership terms and return of University materials in commercial/legal review.
If PHI/ePHI is made available, resolve Business Associate Agreement duties, security/privacy obligations, breach/indemnity and insurance requirements before performance.
Proposal must stand alone; selected proposers may face oral presentation, negotiation and/or best-and-final-offer process.
Recover and bind current first-party packet plus all addenda; a secondary mirror cannot authorize submission.
Total proposed cost must not exceed $750,000.

requirements.requirement: Clinical scope may extend to clinical decision support, diagnostic and patient-facing applications; any such solution requires applicable regulatory compliance, human-in-the-loop controls and clinical validation before production deployment.

Do not assume an incumbent consulting integrator: buyer states there is no incumbent systems integrator, reseller, implementation partner, or incumbent vendor engaged to provide these consulting services.
